text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Everything I do keeps backfiring...
Guess life really is just RNG after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Rulership feeling unwell,
I decided to let her rest in the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I wanna go back to my room... I just wanna
study strategies for *The Empress and the Demon King* that I bought yesterday...
choice_data_list: Alright, alright, board games can wait until you're feeling better.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Messenger A
text_block_list.text:
—R-Report for the Division Commander!
The main Demon Lord army has broken through the defense line and is approaching!

text_block_list.name: Division Commander
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Do not panic, everything is accounted for.
Attack with the mage squad stationed right in front of the river where we lured them!

text_block_list.name: Adjutant
text_block_list.text:
"However, the river isn't that wide!
Won't the monsters easily cross over...?!"

text_block_list.name: Division Commander
text_block_list.text:
Worry not! As long as we establish favorable conditions,
failure is impossible!

text_block_list.name: Division Commander
text_block_list.text: Here goes: the roll of destiny...!

text_block_list.name: Division Commander
text_block_list.text: Hahaa! A massive success...!

text_block_list.name: Messenger B
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! The horde of monsters that stepped into the river are—
frozen solid by the blizzard...!

text_block_list.name: Ice Magician
text_block_list.text:
—Sleep for eternity.
In this frozen world.

text_block_list.name: Division Commander
text_block_list.text: Now the Demon King's army has had its forces completely devastated!

text_block_list.name: Division Commander
text_block_list.text:
"Troops, advance!
Press the attack until they surrender!"

text_block_list.name: Her Majesty the Empress
text_block_list.text:
Your subjugation of the Demon King's army... splendid work.
The peace of this kingdom is all thanks to your efforts.

text_block_list.name: Ice Magician
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent command. My arts could only shine
because of this one's clever tactics.

text_block_list.name: Her Majesty the Empress
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. As expected of our division commander of divine strategy.
A great hero born of our "School Kingdom."

text_block_list.name: Division Commander
text_block_list.text: Oh, Your Majesty... your words are far too kind. I shall vanquish the Demon Lord's army as many times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Soldiers
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH! Glory to the Division Commander!
Glory to Lord Rulership!

text_block_list.name: Division Commander
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa!
That's right, everything is dancing in the palm of my hand!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm~♪
choice_data_list: She's suddenly in a great mood...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, I'm fine now.
Looks like I'll make good progress on conquering "The Empress and the Demon King" too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what happened, but it seems she's out of her slump.
